relevance_note: Table 4 lists 23 individually numbered SSADHD participants with their two ALDH5A1 variants and clinical features; the study 'included genetically confirmed SSADHD participants'.
method_note: A Python script in the scratch directory transcribed Table 4 (23 rows, the only per-patient table); its output was checked against the table (cell counts, variant strings, Yes/No values) and every span was verified verbatim. Labels: Table 4 has a '#' column of bare numbers, so labels are 'Table 4 #<n>' (the text refers to them as '#1', '#2', '#20' etc. by the same table index). Age: Table 4 'Age (years)' is recorded as age at last evaluation (age at the study MRI visit; the paper does not say it differently); ISO uses decimal years as printed. Variants: 'Pathogenic variant 1' and 'Pathogenic variant 2' columns; where both columns give the same string (#9, #10, #13, #14, #18, #19) one variant row was written; zygosity is left 'not reported' because the paper never states zygosity per person (only 'bi‐allelic ALDH5A1 pathogenic variants' in general). Strings kept as printed, including 'c. 803G>A' (#15) and 'c.104_127 del' (#22). No transcript or protein notation printed. Pathogenicity 'pathogenic variant' comes from the column headers. The 'Structure/function affected in protein (SSADH)' column is an in silico assessment of each participant's variant combination, not a per-variant functional assay, so functional_evidence_statement is 'not reported'; ALDH5A1 blood expression (2^ΔCT), plasma GABA/GHB and MRS GABA/NAA values were not recorded as features (no per-person abnormal/normal statement). Features: Epilepsy, Movement disorders and Behavior problems columns are 'Yes'/'No' words; 'No' was read as an explicit statement of absence (excluded). 'Movement disorders' and 'Behavior problems' were not mapped to narrower checklist items (ataxia, dystonia, aggression, etc.), which stay 'not reported'; only 'seizures or epilepsy' is filled. Text confirms #1 and #2 had no seizures and #20–#23 had epilepsy. Dysmyelinated areas were recorded one feature row per area using the table's abbreviation key; cells written 'BG PAWM' (no comma) were read as BG and PAWM. Dysmyelination was not equated with T2 hyperintensity, so the MRI checklist item is 'not reported'. Medications '—' was treated as not reported (the dash is not defined). Figure 1 shows a 9‐year old, a 24 year‐old and a 3‐year old individual who cannot be matched uniquely to table rows; not used. Sex is given only as a group count (12/11); no per-person sex. cohort_size_as_stated = 44 includes the 21 healthy controls (out of scope, no rows). No contradictions found. No stacked ' / ' cells in Table 4.
